summary: Confirmed $50 base, high $100.99->$110.99 at peak; added 50 amp, 100 ft, May 1-Oct 15. Passes the gate on one site type only. Note cleaned of fee and rating.
flags: GATE: passes exactly: $50 for the 'Back In, 30 Amps, Full Hookups' type in both June and July 2027, then $59.27/$71.52 and up. Acadia NP is 44 km, just outside the gateway limit. Not a Good Sam Park. RV Life: tier $$$$, avg $73; campers 8-10/2026: $45 and $50 on sites 33 and 14 with the KOA discount, $72 motorhome site 36 with the discount, $81-82 without. How many sites are in the $50 type is unread; it had no 'sold out' on the dates read.
REVIEWS: Google 4.4/232; RV Life 61 reviews, 4.5 stored. KOA: 'Very nice picnic slabs, and level sites. Trash service sweet.' (9/13/2026).
LONG-STAY: nothing read on KOA's page.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront stands. Imagery: three wooded RV clusters inland; a small pond ~150 m SW of the pin and another ~250 m NW, across the access road and not at sites.
PIN OK: stored 44.57037,-68.75286 sits among the clusters, and is within 50 m of Google's 44.5703,-68.75248.
